The passing single-suite captures were produced with Vitest 5.0.3 (`vitest run --globals --reporter=json --outputFile=vitest.json`) and Jest 30.2.0 (`jest --runInBand --json --outputFile=jest.json`). Each runner executed `test('adds', () => expect(2 + 3).toBe(5));`. Only the suite name's checkout prefix was replaced with `<root>`. The integration test supplies its temporary absolute path.
